notes.title: Partial Reset Results Are Recorded but Not Enforced Before Arena Reuse
notes.problem: ResetMapService can resolve with skippedChunks after a coverage recovery failure, while reuse consumers do not reject reuse solely because skippedChunks is non-empty.
notes.action: Retry or resolve skipped chunks before cleanup completes, or surface a hard reset failure that blocks reuse.

evidence.finding: processChunksOverTime() records skippedChunks and resolves; reuse does not inspect skippedChunks.

notes.title: Kit Selection Immediately Reapplies Loadout Without an Explicit Gameplay-Phase Gate
notes.problem: setSelectedKit() persists the selection, clears effects and immediately reapplies loadout without an explicit session-phase authorization check. Current source does not establish that combat-time kit changes are forbidden by Defense design.
notes.action: Define one authoritative kit-change policy; if preparation-only, enforce it at effect commit.

evidence.finding: setSelectedKit() has no GameManager phase check and immediately calls applySelectedKitNow().

notes.title: Several World-Mutating Script Events Do Not Use the Existing Developer Permission Owner
notes.problem: Several reset/force mutation handlers do not call PermissionService.canUseDeveloperTools(), while skip_level does. Ordinary-player command reachability is not claimed.
notes.action: Route every developer/admin world or session mutation through one explicit PermissionService gate.

evidence.finding: reset/force handlers and reset-map event lack the same internal permission owner used by skip_level.

notes.title: Admin Grant Secret Is Embedded in the Production Behavior Script
notes.problem: Permission configuration contains a literal admin grant/revoke secret in the distributed production BP.
notes.action: Use host/operator-controlled authorization rather than a static secret recoverable from the distributed pack.

evidence.finding: permissionConfig contains a literal secretCode used by PermissionService.

notes.title: Dedicated Persistent-Shop Preservation Helper Is Unused
notes.problem: A dedicated persistent-shop capture helper exists but the current loadout path relies on generic non-kit preservation instead.
notes.action: Remove the dead helper/option contract or connect one clear preservation owner.

evidence.finding: Persistent-shop-specific helper is defined without a production caller.

notes.title: Command-Delivered Shop Purchase Is Not Atomic
notes.problem: For giveCommand items, coins and purchase telemetry are committed before command delivery succeeds; failure has no rollback. Current source does not prove the configured Speed Potion command fails.
notes.action: Commit charge/telemetry after delivery succeeds, or refund/rollback on failure.

evidence.finding: _executePurchase() consumes coins and notifies purchase before awaiting giveCommand; catch path does not refund.

notes.title: Block-Break Scheduling Budget Is Shared Across All Six Arenas
notes.problem: BlockBreakService scans arenas in fixed order with global concurrency/start counters. Source proves coupling but not starvation or objective corruption.
notes.action: Use per-arena budgets or fair rotation if independent timing is required.

evidence.finding: scanAllArenas() uses one global start counter and one global breakStates cap across arena_1 through arena_6.

notes.title: CombatTracker Team-Wipe Comment Contradicts the Implemented Defense Outcome
notes.problem: A source comment says Defense wipes do not end the game, while GameManager routes team_wipe into level defeat/retry. The implemented path is treated as current behavior.
notes.action: Update or remove the stale comment.

evidence.finding: CombatTracker comment and GameManager team-wipe consumer describe different outcomes.

notes.title: Level 15 Completion-Coin Entry Is Unreachable
notes.problem: LEVEL_COMPLETION_COINS contains a 25-coin Level 15 entry, but completion coins are awarded only when a next level exists. Current source does not establish that final victory must award those coins.
notes.action: Remove the dead Level 15 entry or explicitly award it on final victory if intended.

evidence.finding: Level 15 goes directly to victory; awardLevelCompletionCoins() is called only on the next-level branch.
